title: Myer: 20% Cashback (Capped at $50 Per Member) @ TopCashback AU
body:
Deal: Myer: 20% Cashback (Capped at $50 Per Member) @ TopCashback AU

[kerfuffle] You can; you just can't use any MyerOne rewards
[jmc787] Deal timing needs to be updated because it says "later today" but its active now. I had an order track at 20% a few minutes ago.
[Presley] Just want to confirm 20% cashback is applicable across multiple transactions as long as the total cashback is not more than $50?
[grasstown] Yes, that is how I read it. $50 per member. So I read it as over many transactions. And if I was doing click and collect, I would probably split them.
[Dr ninja] Is the 20% TopCashback offer not eligible for multiple Myer transactions? I made 4 separate purchases and they initially tracked at around $50 cashback each, but now 3 have changed to $0. Does anyone know if this is because the $50 cap applies to max one transaction only?
